name: Ohio
overview: Ohio offers bill-level nonbusiness and owner-occupancy credits plus a means-tested homestead value exemption; qualifying levy composition matters.

programs.name: Non-Business Credit
programs.maximumBenefit: 10% of qualifying levies under the pre-reform structure.
programs.formulaSummary: Reduces qualifying residential and agricultural property levies; it is not 10% of every tax bill.
programs.application: Administered on property-tax bills by county auditor.
eligibilityNotes: Residential rental property may qualify at the property-owner level; this is not a payment to renters.

programs.name: Owner Occupancy Credit
programs.maximumBenefit: 2.5% of qualifying levies for the 2025 baseline.
programs.formulaSummary: Owner-occupancy reduction applies to eligible levies, not necessarily the complete property-tax bill.

programs.name: Homestead Exemption
programs.ageRule: 65 or older; permanently and totally disabled; or qualifying surviving spouse age 59 or older.
programs.incomeDefinition: 2024 Ohio modified adjusted gross income for 2025 real-property relief; pre-2014 recipients may be grandfathered.
programs.incomeLimits: $40,000 for tax year 2025 real property; grandfather and enhanced-exemption rules apply.
programs.maximumBenefit: Tax on up to $29,000 true home value; enhanced exemption up to $58,000 for qualifying veterans and survivor categories.
programs.formulaSummary: Exempts a specified portion of home value; enhanced exemptions apply to qualifying disabled veterans and surviving spouses of public-service officers.
eligibilityNotes: Local-option supplemental homestead exemption requires county adoption.

sources.title: H.B. 96 final tax analysis: homestead exemptions

laterChanges: Later legislation changes owner-occupancy and nonbusiness credit percentages; keep post-2025 rates separate.
researchNotes: October 2025 Tax Commissioner certification resolves older summaries: $29,000/$58,000 value reductions apply to 2025 real-property tax collected in 2026. The $41,000 income threshold in the same document applies to 2026 real-property tax, not 2025.
Credits require eligible levy information, not only a total tax bill.
